name: Hollowmere
worldBackground: Hollowmere is a small farming hamlet pressed against the eaves of an old, dark forest. Its people gather at the green around the inn and chapel, while the millrace clatters at the village edge and woodcutters keep wary watch on the tree line. The mood is quiet and practical, but tension simmers over shrinking fields, thinning firewood, and strange tracks found after dusk.

setting.technology: pre-industrial; watermill, hand tools, oil lamps
setting.climate: temperate, cool and damp with misty mornings

zones.name: Hollowmere Green
zones.description: The trampled heart of the hamlet, ringed by cottages and busy with daily village life.

buildings.name: The Wayfarer's Rest
buildings.purpose: serve travelers and villagers food, drink, and beds

buildings.name: Chapel of Saint Aethel
buildings.purpose: hold prayers, weddings, and quiet refuge

zones.name: Millrace Bank
zones.description: A muddy bank where the stream turns the old mill wheel and carts haul sacks to and from the green.

buildings.name: Old Mill
buildings.purpose: grind village grain with the millrace

buildings.name: Granary Shed
buildings.purpose: store sacks of flour and seed grain

zones.name: Old Forest Edge
zones.description: Where fields give way to ancient oaks, brambles, and a path kept open only by woodcutters.

templates.name: Wooden table
templates.description: A scrubbed trestle table where villagers share bread, ale, and the day's news.
templates.physicalDescription: A pale rectangular plank top on two trestle legs, grain lines and knife scars visible from above.
templates.rule: Scatter several through the inn's common room away from the door; a cottage keeps one against wall:east.

templates.name: Wooden stool
templates.description: A three-legged stool, worn smooth by years of sitting.
templates.physicalDescription: A small round seat with three splayed leg dots around it, dark with hand-polish.
templates.rule: Place around:Wooden table, two or three per table, and one beside:Workbench.

templates.name: Straw bed
templates.description: A straw tick under coarse blankets, the only bed most folk here will ever know.
templates.physicalDescription: A narrow rectangle of heaped pale straw with a darker folded blanket at one end.
templates.rule: One per sleeping room, wall:north or wall:west with the head against the wall.

templates.name: Cottage hearth
templates.description: A banked stone fire that keeps the damp out of the cottage and the pot simmering.
templates.physicalDescription: A square of grey fieldstone with a dark soot-black centre and an iron pot ring.
templates.rule: One per cottage on wall:south or wall:west, never within two cells of the bed.

templates.name: Oil lamp
templates.description: A clay lamp of fish oil whose small flame is all the light Hollowmere has after dusk.
templates.physicalDescription: A tiny dark oval with a bright pinprick of flame and a faint glow halo.
templates.rule: One on the inn's bar counter and on every cottage table; none in the granary or the charcoal lean-to.

templates.name: Storage chest
templates.description: An iron-banded chest holding winter wool, seed, and whatever must stay dry.
templates.physicalDescription: A small dark rectangle with two iron bands across the lid and a hasp at the front.
templates.rule: At the foot of every straw bed, and one against wall:west of the chapel for vestments.

templates.name: Barrel
templates.description: An oak barrel of ale, salt fish, or rain water, hooped tight against the damp.
templates.physicalDescription: A round cask seen from above: concentric dark rings with a lighter lid and a bung dot.
templates.rule: Behind:Inn bar counter stacked two deep against the wall, and a pair in the granary corner.

templates.name: Inn bar counter
templates.description: The long plank counter where the innkeeper pours ale and settles accounts.
templates.physicalDescription: A long stout board on end-grain supports, cups and a lamp dotting its top.
templates.rule: Against wall:north of the inn's common room, facing the tables and opposite the door.

templates.name: Chapel pew
templates.description: A plain oak bench where the hamlet kneels and fidgets through the saint's day service.
templates.physicalDescription: A long narrow bench with a low back rail, dark wood with pale worn seats.
templates.rule: Three or four in rows on row:east and row:west, all facing the altar at the chapel's north end.

templates.name: Stone altar
templates.description: A slab of grey stone under a horn lantern, where Saint Aethel's few rites are spoken.
templates.physicalDescription: A pale square block with a cloth runner and two candle dots at its corners.
templates.rule: Center of the chapel's north end, against wall:north, with pews facing it.

templates.name: Smith's forge
templates.description: A soot-blackened hearth where the smith coaxes charcoal into horseshoe heat.
templates.physicalDescription: A blocky stone hearth with a glowing orange core and a hood shadow spreading north.
templates.rule: Against wall:east of the smithy with its chimney breast, well clear of the tool rack.

templates.name: Anvil
templates.description: A stub of iron on a stump, ringing out every repair in Hollowmere.
templates.physicalDescription: A small dark square with a pointed horn jutting toward the forge side.
templates.rule: Center of the smithy floor, one pace from the forge and clear of the door.

templates.name: Workbench
templates.description: A scarred bench of tools and half-finished work, always underfoot.
templates.physicalDescription: A narrow plank bench scattered with small dark tool shapes and shavings.
templates.rule: Wall:west of the smithy, wall:south of the woodcutter's hut, and wall:north of the lean-to.

templates.name: Tool rack
templates.description: Pegs of axes, tongs, and billhooks kept sharp against damp and rust.
templates.physicalDescription: A dark rail with short tool hafts hanging in a row like small teeth.
templates.rule: Wall:any in the smithy beside the forge, and wall:north inside the woodcutter's hut.

templates.name: Millstone
templates.description: The great stone that turns the hamlet's grain into flour all winter long.
templates.physicalDescription: A pale circular stone with radial grooves and a dark square hole at its centre.
templates.rule: Center of the Old Mill floor, with the millrace shaft entering from the stream side.

templates.name: Grain sack
templates.description: A bulging sack of flour or seed, tied at the neck and stencilled with the miller's mark.
templates.physicalDescription: A rounded pale lump with a darker cinched top and a small ink mark.
templates.rule: Cluster in the granary beside:Workbench, and two or three beside:Millstone in the Old Mill.

templates.name: Village well
templates.description: The one well on the green, its rope groaning every misty morning.
templates.physicalDescription: A ring of grey stones around a black water circle, with a timber frame and windlass bar.
templates.rule: Exactly one, center of Hollowmere Green where the trampled paths cross.

templates.name: Market stall
templates.description: A trestle under sacking where eggs, turnips, and wool change hands on market day.
templates.physicalDescription: A square canopy of grey-brown cloth over a plank top dotted with produce.
templates.rule: Cluster along the green's south edge with fronts facing the village well.

templates.name: Notice board
templates.description: A leaning board of nailed scraps: tithes, lost goats, and warnings about the tree line.
templates.physicalDescription: A small dark post with a pale pinned square showing two or three pale paper flecks.
templates.rule: Edge of the green beside:Village well, angled to face the inn's door.

templates.name: Woodpile
templates.description: Split logs stacked under a leak of thatch, counted and hoarded against the cold.
templates.physicalDescription: A tight grid of pale log ends stacked in rows, darker bark at the edges.
templates.rule: Behind:Thatcher's Cottage and beside the inn's kitchen wall; never within the chapel.

templates.name: Mill pond
templates.description: Still brown water above the wheel, misted over until mid-morning.
templates.physicalDescription: A wide dark blue-green patch with pale ripple lines and reeds specking the shore.
templates.rule: Beside:Old Mill on the upstream side, feeding the millrace.

templates.name: Footbridge
templates.description: Two planks and a handrail, the quickest way over the millrace with a sack on your shoulder.
templates.physicalDescription: A narrow plank span in brown wood with a thin rail line along one side.
templates.rule: Across the millrace beside:Old Mill, on the woodcutters' side of the bank.

templates.name: Sack cart
templates.description: A two-wheeled cart of flour sacks and chaff, parked where the mud is firmest.
templates.physicalDescription: A small brown rectangle with two dark wheel dots, heaped pale sacks on top.
templates.rule: Front:Old Mill on the dirt track, and a second one front:Granary Shed.

templates.name: Willow tree
templates.description: A bowed willow trailing its pale branches in the millrace.
templates.physicalDescription: A rounded pale-green crown with long drooping strands over the water side.
templates.rule: Along the millrace bank at the edge of Millrace Bank, three or four spread along the water.

templates.name: Oak tree
templates.description: An old dark oak, one of the eaves the hamlet has never dared cut back.
templates.physicalDescription: A broad dark-green crown with a knotty trunk hole at its centre and deep shadow.
templates.rule: Scatter through Old Forest Edge, densest along the zone edge away from the woodcutters' path.

templates.name: Bramble bush
templates.description: A snarl of thorn and blackberry that tears at sleeves and hides the tree line.
templates.physicalDescription: A small dark tangle of thorny arcs with a few dull berry dots.
templates.rule: Scatter along_path of the woodcutters' path, thickening to a wall at the forest edge.

templates.name: Boundary stone
templates.description: A mossy marker stone showing where the last tilled field ends and the forest begins.
templates.physicalDescription: A small grey upright stone with a pale lichen cap and a chiselled line.
templates.rule: Along_path where the fields meet the trees, one every few cells of cleared ground.

templates.name: Fallen log
templates.description: A moss-eaten trunk brought down by wind, too far in to be worth hauling out.
templates.physicalDescription: A long brown cylinder with a pale sawn end, speckled with green moss patches.
templates.rule: Scatter in Old Forest Edge well away from the woodcutters' path, never across a doorway.

templates.name: Mushroom ring
templates.description: A pale ring of toadstools on the damp grass, which the woodcutters will not step inside.
templates.physicalDescription: A faint circle of small cream caps on a darker green patch of grass.
templates.rule: Edge of Old Forest Edge in damp shade, never on the woodcutters' path.

templates.name: Charcoal mound
templates.description: A turf-covered clamp of slow-burning wood, smoking for days under the burner's eye.
templates.physicalDescription: A dark earth dome ringed with sod, a thin grey smoke plume and a black vent hole.
templates.rule: Behind:Charcoal Burner's Lean-to in a cleared circle, well clear of the oak trunks.

rooms.name: Common Room
rooms.purpose: tavern hall for food, drink, and village gossip

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.purpose: cooking and food preparation for guests

rooms.name: Private Guest Room
rooms.purpose: private bed for a paying traveler

rooms.name: Nave
rooms.purpose: Prayers, weddings, and quiet refuge before the altar

rooms.name: Vestry
rooms.purpose: Storage for vestments and chapel linens

rooms.name: Forge Floor
rooms.purpose: shoeing horses and mending farm tools

rooms.name: Mill Floor
rooms.purpose: grinding floor around the water-driven millstone

rooms.name: Sack Store
rooms.purpose: grain storage and sack mending beside the mill floor

rooms.name: Miller's Rest
rooms.purpose: sleeping nook and meals for the miller

rooms.name: Sack Store
rooms.purpose: Raised, dry storage for flour sacks hauled up from the millrace carts, kept off the damp ground on a plank floor

rooms.name: Seed Room
rooms.purpose: Small partitioned bay holding next season's seed grain in sacks, kept dark and cool away from the door

rooms.name: Main Room
rooms.purpose: family living and cooking room with the cottage table and hearth

rooms.name: Sleeping Room
rooms.purpose: small sleeping room for the miller's family

rooms.name: Main Hut
rooms.purpose: Shelter for woodcutters with sleeping, eating, and tool storage

rooms.name: Lean-to Workshop
rooms.purpose: Covered workspace and storage for charcoal burning gear

npcs.name: Alys Fletcher
npcs.description: Keeps six beds, two ale barrels, and a pot of barley stew going; wants a reliable lad to split firewood and worries the forest tracks will scare off winter travelers.
npcs.physicalDescription: Broad-shouldered and red-cheeked, in a patched wool kirtle and apron, with a brass key ring at her belt.

npcs.name: Osric Miller
npcs.description: Runs the Old Mill with two flour-dusted helpers and one stubborn wheel; wants the millrace dredged before the freeze and worries the granary sacks are lighter each week.
npcs.physicalDescription: Lean and stooped, in a flour-whitened tunic and leather cap, with a permanent squint from watching the wheel.

npcs.name: Maud Thatcher
npcs.description: Farms three narrow strips at the green’s edge and keeps eight hens; wants a fair price for her barley and worries the shrinking fields will not feed her family through winter.
npcs.physicalDescription: Short and weathered, in a mud-hemmed gown and tied straw hat, with a sickle always tucked in her rope belt.

npcs.name: Edwin Smith
npcs.description: Shoes horses and mends tools at one cold forge with a hand bellows; wants a steady supply of charcoal and worries the woodcutters are cutting too near the old trees.
npcs.physicalDescription: Thick-armed and soot-smudged, in a leather apron over a singed tunic, with a burn scar on his left thumb.

npcs.name: Wulfric Holt
npcs.description: Marks two hundred trees for winter felling and keeps a wary eye on the tree line; wants the strange tracks identified and worries his youngest lad will follow them alone.
npcs.physicalDescription: Tall and grizzled, in a hooded green cloak and hobnailed boots, with a wood-axe notched from many winters.

player.name: Rowan Ashdown
player.description: A hired surveyor with a chain, a compass, and a reeve’s writ to map Hollowmere’s bounds before spring; wants a warm room through the winter and worries the fresh tracks will be blamed on outsiders.
player.physicalDescription: Wiry and travel-stained, in an oiled cloak and mud-caked boots, with a brass compass tied at the wrist.
